safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports dizziness associated with the headache.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold includes associated dizziness; no generated fact explicitly states dizziness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Dizziness associated with an acute new headache and visual changes can be a neurologic red-flag symptom (e.g., posterior circulation pathology) and may influence urgency of evaluation and safety-netting. Omitting it can contribute to under-triage or incomplete differential consideration.
